# viettelcloud_project_custom_role (Resource)

Manage a custom role of the configured Viettel Cloud project. A custom role is a set of IAM actions that can be assigned to project members.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# A role that lets project members operate servers. The backend derives
# name = "doi-van-hanh" from the display name.
resource "viettelcloud_project_custom_role" "example" {
  display_name = "Đội vận hành"
  description  = "Operates the project's servers."

  actions = [
    { urn = "urn:action:server:server:list" },
    { urn = "urn:action:server:server:get" },
  ]
}

# A disabled role that grants no action yet.
resource "viettelcloud_project_custom_role" "placeholder" {
  display_name = "Auditors"
  enabled      = false
  actions      = []
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `actions` (Attributes Set) IAM actions that the Custom Role grants, each referenced by its URN. Each action must exist and be allowed on projects. Set it to an empty set to grant no action. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--actions))
- `display_name` (String) Display name of the Custom Role. Outer whitespace is ignored; the rest must be 1 to 255 characters and contain at least one letter or digit. Its slug must be unique among the project's custom roles. Changing it updates the role in place.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Description of the Custom Role. Outer whitespace is ignored; the rest must be at most 255 characters. Omitting it preserves the current value; set it to an empty string to clear it.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the Custom Role grants its actions. A disabled role grants nothing. Defaults to `true`, so removing the attribute enables the role again.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Timestamp when the Custom Role was created (RFC3339).
- `id` (String) Custom Role ID (UUID).
- `name` (String) Custom Role name, generated once at creation as a slug of display_name, for example `doi-van-hanh` for `Đội vận hành`. Changing display_name later does not change it.
- `updated_at` (String) Timestamp when the Custom Role was last updated (RFC3339).
- `urn` (String) Custom Role URN, `urn:role:prj-<project slug>:<name>`. It is generated at creation and never changes.

<a id="nestedatt--actions"></a>
### Nested Schema for `actions`

Required:

- `urn` (String) URN of the IAM action, for example `urn:action:server:server:all`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import a custom role of the configured project by its ID.
terraform import viettelcloud_project_custom_role.example 00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000
```
